programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Viviendo con Satán/Justicia para mi madre

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Por un riñón / Cómo vengarse de un infiel

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Si cruzas la frontera te mato / Piratería en la industria musical

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Oriel exige la custodia del hijo que tiene con Sindy porque no lo deja comer carne. Además, Willian y Marie están casados, hacen un trío con una escultora y producen dildos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Mina de oro de anciano / Niño extraterrestre

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: María perdió a mi hijo / Felizmente cornudo

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Los mariachis llegan a dar la serenata y se sorprenden al ver que fue contratada por Virginia. Mientras tanto, Rosario busca a Sigifredo para informarle que su hija va a dar a luz. Rosario se llevará una gran sorpresa al ver a Virginia con Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Sigifredo recibe a su nieta en el hospital junto a su esposa y Rosario. Por otro lado, Raquel no para de recordar a Pedro mientras ve a Emiliano sentado en el andén esperando a Rosario y vestido con el mismo traje que era de él.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Thomas les pone plazo de un mes a Corona y a Steve para que paguen los cinco millones de dólares que les decomisó la policía. Por otro lado, Daniela y Laura no le devuelven el sombrero a Emiliano, Virginia prefiere entregarle el sombrero a Raquel.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Duelo de rancheras en el escenario del Plaza Garibaldi, Rosario y Emiliano se retan con canciones sin medir las consecuencias. Los juegos de Virginia continúan funcionando para separar a Emiliano de Rosario.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Javier Macías visita a Raquel para pedirle excusas. Mientras tanto, Lucia sufre un accidente al montar patineta en la calle y debe ser llevada de urgencias a una clínica. Crecen los enfrentamientos entre Emiliano y Javier Macías.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Felipe Romero es condenado a ocho años de cárcel. Por otro lado, Emiliano llega a la clínica para visitar a Lucia y encuentra a Javier Macías con Rosario. Javier sigue encontrando la forma de molestar a Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Thomas continúa presionando a Corona para que consiga los cinco millones de dólares que perdieron. Por otro lado, Martin se entera por boca de Cristina que Felipe recibió una condena de ocho años. Martin no podrá combatir su sentido de culpa.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi

programme.title: La hija del mariachi

programme.title: La hija del mariachi

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Fernando es llevado a la fuerza con el marido de su amante y encuentra a Liliana golpeada y le advierten que debe alejarse de ella. Por otro lado, Emiliano recibe un mail de Cristina donde le cuenta lo de Felipe y le pide que no regrese a México.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano está destrozado por la noticia que recibió sobre la condena de su amigo Felipe. Rosario y Fernando continúan esperándolo en el bar. Mientras tanto, el Coloso delata a Emiliano con don Carlos y este le pone un ultimátum.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Los mariachis le dan serenata a una pareja homosexual sin estar al tanto y por esto el coloso arma un gran escándalo. Por otro lado, Martin no puede combatir su sentido de culpa y le escribe a Emiliano diciéndole que puede ayudarlo.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Martin le comunica a Emiliano que va viajar a Colombia para hablar con él y ayudarlo. Por otro lado, Emiliano enfurece al ver que Javier Macías está recogiendo a Rosario en la universidad.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano le reclama a Javier por usar la deuda que tiene Rosario con él para aprovecharse de ella. Por otro lado, a pesar de las diferencias, Emiliano decide salvar al Coloso de ser descubierto en la cama con una mujer casada.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Virginia encuentra la forma de fastidiar a Emiliano haciéndolo quedar mal con Rosario. En el bar Garibaldi habrá un encuentro de rancheras entre Emiliano y Rosario, un grupo de mujeres despechadas apoyaran a Rosario.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Virginia habla con Rosario para confundirla aún más. Cuatro mujeres que se encuentran en el bar se han solidarizado con Rosario por su gran despecho y la han invitado a tomar con ellas. .

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: En medio de su borrachera, las mujeres despechadas y Rosario, convertirán en cenizas todas las pertenencias del ex marido de una de ellas. Rosario ha humillado a Emiliano y ahora deberá buscar la forma de reivindicarse con él.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Después de varios meses de conquista, discusiones, engaños y perdón, Emiliano y Rosario se entregan en cuerpo y alma uno al otro. Por otro lado, Fernando prepara todo para la llegada de Martin Del Valle a Colombia.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Martin llega a Bogotá y se aloja en el hotel asignado por Fernando. Por otro lado, todos en el bar se llevan una gran sorpresa al ver que Rosario y Emiliano se han reconciliado. El coloso pierde el control y enfrenta a Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Qué bonito amor. Emiliano y Rosario disfrutan de su segunda noche juntos. Mientras tanto, Raquel espera impaciente a Rosario en casa. Por otro lado, Leticia es atracada en la calle y debe recurrir a Fernando para que la ayude.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Todo está listo para el encuentro entre Emiliano y Martin. Emiliano quedará derrumbado y perderá el control al conocer toda la verdad a boca de su cuñado. Emiliano le dará indicaciones a Martin para poder arreglar la situación en la que está.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Leandro reacciona mal luego de haber pasado la noche con Clementina. Clementina se siente culpable y rompe su compromiso con Pepe. Matilde decide ir a buscar a Leandro y ambos aclaran el malentendido. Rodrigo le pide a Pello que lo ayude a vengarse.

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.
A college student's murder haunts a community for years; with the verdict just in, jurors, investigators and friends reveal new details.

programme.desc: After finding gold, an elderly miner is attacked by three thugs. He manages to kill two of the crooks before the third one murders him and flees. The local law enforcement is confounded by the case, so they enlist the sharpest sleuth in the West -- "Silver" Ward Hogan (Jock Mahoney) -- to find the surviving culprit and decipher the victim's cryptic will. With the help of fiery rancher Mary Kingman (Kim Hunter), Ward sets out to find the fugitive and the heirs to the old man's treasure.

programme.title: Best of the Badmen
programme.desc: After the North defeats the South, Union Maj. Jeff Clanton (Robert Ryan) heads to Missouri to provide the Confederacy's Quantrill's Raiders a chance to claim allegiance to the Union, thereby clearing their wanted status. But standing in Clanton's way are the corrupt lawmen Joad (Barton MacLane) and Fowler (Robert Preston), who would rather keep the men outlaws to collect the reward on their heads. After Joad and Fowler frame Clanton for murder, he manages to escape, becoming an outlaw himself.

programme.title: Ride, Vaquero
programme.desc: After the Civil War, King Cameron (Howard Keel) moves to Texas, purchases a cattle ranch and settles down with his wife, Cordelia (Ava Gardner). They find themselves at the mercy of Jose Esqueda (Anthony Quinn), a local bandit who has terrorized the town with his adoptive brother, Rio (Robert Taylor). Rio is kidnapped when he tries to mount an attack on the ranch and agrees to work for Cameron so he can be close to Cordelia. Though he's incensed at Rio's betrayal, Jose vows to get him back.

programme.title: Billy the Kid
programme.desc: The story of the notorious outlaw William "Billy the Kid" Bonney. Billy joins a group of outlaws in a South West town when he meets old friend Jim Sherwood, now the town's marshal. He tries to change his ways but when a friend is murdered he falls back into the life of a bandit.

programme.title: Devil's Doorway
programme.desc: Lance Poole (Robert Taylor) is a Native American who left his tribal homelands to fight for the Union in the Civil War. Despite earning the Congressional Medal of Honor for his heroic duties in the line of fire, when he returns home he's still faced with hatred and racism from the white community that neighbors his village. Unable to own property because he's not considered a citizen of the United States, he fights a lawyer's (Louis Calhern) attempts to take over his tribe's hard-earned land.

programme.title: Many Rivers to Cross
programme.desc: A determined young woman gives new meaning to ‘shotgun wedding’ while pursuing a certain Kentucky backwoodsman through the 1798 American frontier.

programme.title: Westward the Women
programme.desc: There's a deficit of good, honest women in the West, and Roy Whitman (John McIntire) wants to change that. His solution is to bring a caravan of over 100 mail-order brides from Chicago to California. It will be a long, difficult and dangerous journey for the women. So Whitman hires hardened, cynical Buck Wyatt (Robert Taylor) to be their guide across the inhospitable frontier. But as disaster strikes on the trail, Buck just might discover that these women are stronger than he thinks.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The closing of what was once a very popular public garden in Midsomer Deverell sparks a series of murders that have Inspector Barnaby and Sgt. Troy stumped.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Following the funeral of local hotelier Karl Wainwright, his hotel's manager and a well liked Punch and Judy performer, Gregory Chambers, disappears unusually in yet another picturesque Midsomer village. Most people dismiss his disappearance completely but when he doesn't turn up, a search is conducted and a severed hand, confirmed to be Gregory's, turns up in the woods. Further deaths and a mushroom poisoning occur surrounding the beneficiaries of Karl Wainwright's will. All is not as it seems.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A man's naked body found under mysterious circumstances, within a crop circle on Sir Harry Chatwyn's wheat field, leads police to investigating how he wound up in the field after being electrocuted. While the nearby village of Midsomer Parva is abuzz with UFO mania, Barnaby is unconvinced by a local ufologist that the man's death was the result of alien activity, as he uncovers rivalries, theft and hatred during his investigations, soon after a well known burglar is found dead in another crop circle with identical injuries.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Returning home one night, in a drunken state, the local doctor of Newton Magna calls in the police after he had accidentally hit a man, yet when Barnaby and Troy arrive, the injured man is nowhere to be found. As they investigate the mystery, Barnaby encounters an old adversary who is working to help renovate the village and whose daughter is getting married to a local boy. Matters soon become complicated, when the body of the best man's father is found in a well that was being renovated, whom the detectives soon discover had disappeared on the day he was planning to run away with a local farmer's wife.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Dave Cutler, Goodman's Land's amorous postman, is found almost decapitated near the common early one morning. Newspaper girl Holly Reid (Kate Maberly) tells Barnaby that she heard music playing faintly nearby. Barnaby and Troy are aided in their investigations by local WPC Jay Nash (Gillian Kearney).

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: As the Barnabys prepare for Cully's wedding, Lord Fitzroy and Beth Porteous are married in the pretty village of Bledlow. At the lavish reception at Bledlow Hall that follows, however, tragedy strikes - maid of honour Marina Fellowes is found murdered in one of the rooms by some of the guests. With their honeymoon cancelled, the Fitzroys must contend with a police presence in their home, as Barnaby and Jones try to learn more about the family history. It soon becomes clear there are secrets, deception, and an illegtimate son involved in the mystery, which is further complicated when the estate manager is killed by an arrow.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: It's a good day for the Hicks family, as the name of Tommy Hicks - who was executed during World War I for "cowardice and desertion" - is added to the list on Midsomer Parva's war memorial. Tommy's son Lionel and grandson Dave, mayor of Causton and whom Barnaby does not like (owing to dodgy building work by the mayor's company), are thrilled, but the snooty Hammonds are decidedly less pleased. Henry, the patriarch of the Hammond family, is particularly riled by his insalubrious neighbours, and has nurtured a long-running feud with the Hickses. But the evening after a battle re-enactment in the village, Henry is murdered - and Barnaby must delve into the history of the two families to find the killer, discovering a web of fraud, lies, and hidden truths.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones are in Dunstan to investigate the deaths of a reclusive couple. As they try to establish whether Ron and Libby Wilson were murdered or died of natural causes, their attention is drawn to a dispute raging between a local builder and road protesters nearby. When another death occurs, the detectives learn that there are plenty of dark secrets and fierce hostilities in this apparently idyllic village. Will Jack Purdy's quick temper lead to violence? How far would the protesters go to prevent the bypass being built? And do current events somehow relate to the death of Michael Wilson many years earlier?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the body of Londoner Charlie Finleyson is discovered in woodland near Midsomer Sonning, Barnaby and Jones find themselves investigating employees at local Midsomer Life magazine. It turns out the dead man was married to the ex-wife of Guy Sandys, the wealthy owner of the publication. As the detectives become aware of a feud between Guy and the proprietor of the Morecroft Hotel, tensions are also heating up between the locals and visiting Londoners. Soon Barnaby and Jones find themselves to trying to piece together the truth about the murder, and learn that someone might be trying to conceal something in their past.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a pub landlady is crushed to death during a magic show in Midsomer Oaks, Barnaby and Nelson uncover conflict between the village church and ancient pagan traditions. Is famous magician Gideon Latimer to blame or is he the target?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones are forced to take part in a team building exercise and Tom has plenty of problems dealing with the young, new, acting Chief Superintendent, John Cotton (Nick Fletcher). Following an explosion in a truck that had been stored in a truck depot, a body is soon discovered in a nearby lake, which turns out to be Alec Grainger, who had been seen arguing with James Parkes (Joseph Millson), the son of Colonel Matt Parkes (Tim Pigott-Smith). James appears to be involved in shady business deals and is blamed by his grandmother Caroline Halsey (Judy Parfitt) - and others - for the suicide of a woman he got pregnant two years before. Barnaby and Jones find themselves delving into a mixture of fraud, smuggling, and lies, trying to piece together the truth.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When two couples vanish into thin air in the village of Monks Barton, Barnaby and Jones hear rumours of haunted woods and witchcraft. Barnaby remains sceptical of this, even when an unidentified body is found in a shallow grave and the missing start turning up dead. He soon has to determine if ghosts, criminals, or something else, is behind the abductions and murders.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The residents of Milton Cross, a feudal estate with a church, farms, houses and acres of land, depend on lord of the manor Edward Milton for their livelihoods. But when Sonia Woodley is stabbed in the churchyard two years after the death of her abusive husband Gerald, Barnaby and Jones investigate, trying to work out who killed her. It soon becomes clear someone took a pair of tailor scissors to do the deed, but who amongst the villagers could have done so, is unclear, and the investigation is complicated, when the pair learn the local Anglican priest, the parish vicar, had received a letter from Sonia. When he himself is killed, the pair believe something in the letter may be key to solving the mystery.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby is not convinced about Mayor David Hicks' plans to revive an annual trip to Brighton, suspecting his proposal to buy coastal land there, is rather a fraudulent scheme. programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance.After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

In Desert Ghost, Will Cooper heads west to Marathon, Texas, with longtime friend and mentor Cody Roberts to hunt aoudad in one of the most remote landscapes in the state. Rooted in family legacy, this film explores Cody’s deep ties to the desert, the story behind Desert Ghost Distillery, and the mystique of a western oasis near Big Bend National Park. More than a hunt, Desert Ghost dives into the role of aoudad management and its importance to desert bighorn sheep conservation efforts led by Texas Parks and Wildlife and the Wild Sheep Foundation. programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.title: Angry Planet | Hot and Cold Crystals
programme.desc: Miners in Chihauhau, Mexico, has just discovered an amazing sight. Deep in the earth, only 300 feet from a pocket of molten magma, is an amazing chamber filled with giant blue and pink crystals – some as big as 60 feet long! It is an extraordinary find – and one that is very difficult to witness, as temperatures run to 150 F, with 100% humidity. The Mexican authorities are only opening up the cavern to scientists and film crews – “Angry Planet” plans to be one of the first in!

programme.title: Angry Planet | Hawaii
programme.desc: We have filmed extensively in Hawaii, filming big-wave surfing at the famous Banzai Pipeline on Oahu's North Shore, and filming George surfing with the “Hawaian Fire” firefighters. We have also filmed at the Hawaii Tsunami Institute and in Hilo, site of major Tsunami damage in both 1946 and 1964. We also have filmed extensively at Kilawea Volcano, filming the amazing sight of rivers and waterfalls of red hot lava flowing into the Pacific Ocean.

programme.title: Angry Planet | Kenya
programme.desc: Definitely our wildest episode so far. Here's the deal: Mt. Elgon is an 14,000 foot volcano in eastern Kenya. We propose a safari/ascent of the dormant volcano. Here's the first kicker: High on the the flanks of the volcano is Kitum Cave – a cave created by the most unique form of erosion – Elephant Erosion. For millennia elephants have been going into the cave to carve it out with their tusks in order to eat the salty rock. Here's the second kicker: the cave is thought to be the home of the Ebola Marberg virus – the world's most deadly virus. So here's the plan: We are going enter the cave, at night, wearing full Bio-Hazard suits to protect us from the virus.

programme.title: Angry Planet | Desert Monsoon
programme.desc: Host/adventurer George Kourounis explores the American Southwest during the Desert Monsoon. He ups the danger factor by traveling with wild atheist shock-jock R.J. Evans to track massive lightning storms which can produce bolts of up to one hundred million volts. The pair come close - too close - to dangerous electrical clouds swirling over Tucson, Sedona and Monument Valley.

programme.title: Angry Planet | Fire and Water
programme.desc: With summer wildfires overpowering the Yukon forests, host/adventurer George Kourounis follows the fabled route of the Klondike Gold Rush sourdoughs through the bawdy town of Skagway, Alaska, paddling the white water rivers and the White Horse Rapids into the Yukon. He travels on mountain bike, steam train and Cessna to experience the huge fires and meet the northern fire crews battling the blazes.

programme.title: Angry Planet | Wild Weather of 2005
programme.desc: 2005 saw some of the wildest weather in the history of the planet. Host/adventurer George Kourounis tracks twisters through the Tornado Alley of Oklahoma and Texas, descends into the Erte Ale Volcano in the Danakil Depression of Ethiopia (the world's hottest place), and then witnesses Hurricane Katrina destroying the town of Gulfport, Mississippi, from a steel-reinforced bunker facing the debris-strewn beachfront.

programme.title: Angry Planet | Wild Water
programme.desc: Three explorations into the wild water that makes up over 70% of our angry planet. First, George travels to Guadaloupe Island off the coast of Mexico to dive with 16 foot Great White Sharks. He then uses drysuit and kayak to retrace the explorations of Tom Woodward into a flooded Northern Ontario cave in the middle of winter, then jetboats into the world's biggest Class VI whitewater rapids in the Niagara River.

programme.title: Angry Planet | Blizzard
programme.desc: Mount Washington, New Hampshire has the dubious title of being home to the world's worst weather. The highest wind ever recorded on the planet – 231 miles per hour – was recorded at its mountaintop observatory. To prepare for a mid-winter assault on the summit, Angry Planet host George Kourounis becomes a “human popsicle”, encased in ice in at the National Resarch Council's high speed wind tunnel. Then he and his sidekick Mark Robinson climb to the top of the mountain in mid-January and brave their way into a summit blizzard.

programme.title: Angry Planet | Boiling Lake
programme.desc: Dominica, the most volcanic and mountainous island in the Caribbean, is home to the Boiling Lake, a large waterfall-fed lake of furiously boiling water. Adventurer George Kourounis becomes the first person ever to traverse across the lake on a rope, risking his life to take water samples and shoot video from a place no human has ever been. He then dives to the ocean floor off the coast of the island to explore vents where the superheated water bubbles into the ocean.

programme.title: Angry Planet | Hottest & Coldest
programme.desc: George experiences the most extreme climates in North America. First he visits the hottest place on the continent – Death Valley, then the coldest – Snag, Yukon.

programme.title: Santo: Infraterrestre
programme.desc: Las fuerzas del bien se enfrentan a las malévolas intenciones de los Infraterrestres, seres de otro planeta que intentarán apoderarse de la Tierra.

programme.title: Adiós, New York, adiós
programme.desc: La ciudad de Nueva York es el escenario donde se juntan varias historias protagonizadas por latinos. Una familia puertorriqueña, dos mexicanos y sus amigos buscan fortuna sin olvidar sus raíces y tradiciones.

programme.title: El Mofles y Canek en máscara vs cabellera
programme.desc: Un mecánico inexperto en el deporte de la lucha libre vive toda una aventura cuando se enfrenta a un luchador asesino.

programme.title: Barridos y regados
programme.desc: Cuando dos mensajeros llegan con un recado a una empresa, los confunden con los técnicos a los que esperaban y ellos aprovechan la situación para ganar dinero e impresionar a las bellas secretarias.

programme.title: Mágico, el Enviado de los Dioses
programme.desc: Un héroe enmascarado llamado Mágico llega a la Tierra para pelear contra una fuerza maléfica y defender a los necesitados.

programme.title: La hora del jaguar
programme.desc: Como agente de la policía se caracterizó por ser el más despiadado, ahora retirado, se convierte en asesino a sueldo.

programme.title: El mexicano
programme.desc: Jacinto, un peleador que vence a todos sus rivales en Estados Unidos, ayuda a su hermano que es atacado por unos irlandeses. El antiguo rival de Jacinto mata a su esposa, por lo que Jacinto busca vengarse.

programme.title: Escuadrón salvaje
programme.desc: Los juegos de guerra se tornan mortales para un grupo de jóvenes, cuya alegre excursión culmina en una casa abandonada.

programme.title: Juan Nadie
programme.desc: Juan Nadie es un pistolero al que contratan para matar a un cacique. Juan lo hace y la viuda de este pone precio a su cabeza. Su mala fama lo lleva a ser perseguido por una banda.

programme.title: El Triángulo del Crimen
programme.desc: Un hombre sale de la cárcel, busca la ayuda de un viejo amigo y comprende que entre ellos aún existe la rivalidad que inició durante su infancia.

programme.title: Asesino del Metro
programme.desc: El miedo se impone sobre la Ciudad de México, cuando un asesino a sus víctimas, todas mujeres, en el metro de la ciudad.

programme.title: Por el Poder de la Mara
programme.desc: Un grupo de mafiosos desata una guerra cuando la esposa de un personaje clave para su organización es secuestrada.

programme.title: El corrido de María Pistolas
programme.desc: Un hombre finge estar del lado de los ricos para enterarse de sus planes, y así los revolucionarios venzan en un ataque.

programme.title: Reencuentros
programme.desc: Al morir su hermano de leucemia, un niño pobre toma su bicicleta y emprende un viaje a la ciudad en busca de su padre.

programme.title: El caudillo
programme.desc: Un valiente revolucionario es buscado por las tropas federales, pero el pueblo lo ayuda a esconderse y luego a escapar.

programme.title: Señoritas a Disgusto
programme.desc: Tres mujeres que viven en un pueblo lleno de solteronas alquilan una de sus habitaciones a un apuesto hombre.

programme.title: La Chamuscada
programme.desc: Un peón se une a la revolución y llega a ser coronel de las tropas zapatistas después de huir del maltrato de su patrón.

programme.title: Lázaro Cárdenas
programme.desc: En el pueblo de Palmira, Carranza, se instruye a los niños de las escuelas sobre la labor que el general Cárdenas realizó en México.

programme.title: Renuncia por motivos de salud
programme.desc: Un empleado del gobierno quiere alejarse de la corrupción, pero se ve atrapado entre perderlo todo o unirse al juego.

programme.title: El Deseo
programme.desc: Dos hermanas están enamoradas del mismo hombre, pero una de ella sufre una enfermedad incurable.

programme.title: Limosneros con garrote
programme.desc: Dos músicos y comediantes quedan en la bancarrota, encuentran una bebé en una canasta y deben trabajar para poder conservar a la niña.

programme.title: Secretaria peligrosa
programme.desc: Una secretaria y un gánster planean asaltar al jefe de ella, pero un agente especial logra capturarlos luego del suceso.

programme.title: ¡Que seas feliz!
programme.desc: Una cantante se enamora de un jugador y se casa con él rechazando a su maestro de canto.

programme.title: La Risa de la Ciudad
programme.desc: Las historias de un grupo de artistas callejeros dejan ver lo difícil que es vivir en la gran ciudad, pero también, sus sueños, metas e ilusiones.

programme.title: Suerte te dé Dios
programme.desc: Dos humildes obreros encuentran monedas de oro en una demolición, pero son despedidos y deben ingeniar una manera de apoderarse del tesoro.

programme.title: Los misterios del hampa
programme.desc: Un gánster es detenido en Chicago, le cuenta sobre su vida a su esposa, pero le pide que le diga a su hijo que fue un empresario.

programme.title: La alegría de vivir
programme.desc: Una joven, a quien sus patrones quieren casar con un viejo, conoce a un joven mecánico apuesto y ambos se enamoran.

programme.title: Tiburoneros
programme.desc: Un ambiente de miseria y degeneración donde el humor es enteramente grotesco.

programme.title: Cine
programme.desc: (Drama) Viruta, Capulina.

programme.title: Al son del mambo
programme.desc: Un millonario aburrido va a La Habana a donde lo siguen un grupo de personas y todos juntos se divierten bailando mambo.

programme.title: Mi héroe
programme.desc: Un escritor lleva a su esposa a la vieja casa de sus antepasados, donde son acechados por una serie de fantasmas.

programme.title: El hombre sin rostro
programme.desc: Un médico legista desea renunciar a su trabajo en el Departamento de Policía porque lo atemoriza un asesino de prostitutas y, finalmente, le pide ayuda a un colega.

programme.title: Dicen Que Soy Hombre Malo
programme.desc: Un cacique prohíbe casarse a su sobrina para quedarse con la fortuna que dejó su hermano fallecido para ella.

programme.title: Horas de Agonía
